resources.string: Point the app at your CodeBuddy Code server. The app is a thin shell around the existing web UI; nothing is proxied.
Changing the server reloads the chat. Sessions stay on the server.
Smaller fits more on screen. 0.17× is about 6× smaller than 1.00×.
LAN: use the Linux machine IP and port, for example http://192.168.1.100:7890. Start CodeBuddy with --host 0.0.0.0.
Remote: use an HTTPS reverse proxy or a VPN. Never expose port 7890 directly to the internet.
HTTP is accepted only for private/LAN addresses. Certificate validation is never bypassed.
Enter the server address to begin.
The test checks reachability only. It does not log in.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
Remove the username or password from the URL.
Do not put a password in the URL. Log in inside the app.
Use HTTPS for servers outside your local network.
The URL path contains invalid characters.
The port must be between 1 and 65535.
Server reachable. You can connect now.
The server responded, but it does not look like CodeBuddy Code.
Timed out. Check the IP address, port, and firewall.
Connection refused. Start CodeBuddy with --host 0.0.0.0 and allow the port through the firewall.
Server address not found. Check the URL.
The TLS certificate is not trusted. Use a valid certificate or a private network.
No network connection. Reconnect Wi-Fi, then retry.
The page could not be loaded.
The server TLS certificate is not trusted. Use a valid certificate or connect through a private network.
The server responded with HTTP %1$d. Check the URL and the server logs.
The server responded, but the path was not found. Check the URL path.
The web view stopped unexpectedly. Tap Retry to reload.
Timed out. Check the IP address, port, and firewall.
Connection refused. Start CodeBuddy with --host 0.0.0.0 and allow the port through the firewall.
Connection refused. Start the server with:\ncodebuddy --serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7890\nand allow the port through the firewall.

Nothing is listening on the phone itself. Either run\nadb reverse tcp:7890 tcp:7890\non the computer and keep http://127.0.0.1:7890, or start CodeBuddy with --host 0.0.0.0 and use the computer LAN address.
No response from the server. Check the IP address, make sure CodeBuddy runs with --host 0.0.0.0, and check that a firewall or VPN is not blocking the port.
The page did not finish loading. The server may be busy or the connection blocked. Tap Retry.
Server address not found. Check the URL.
Server address not found. Check the URL and that the device is on the same network.
